content: Kathutkung: Devit, Sawl ni a patoun e naw ni Devit thei hanelah im a ring awh navah sak e la

content.text: Oe ka Cathut, ka taran kut dawk hoi na rungngang haw.
Na ka tarannaw koehoi na hlout sak haw.
Ka payonnaw koehoi na rungngang haw.
Tami kathetnaw kut dawk hoi na rungngang haw.
Ahnimouh ni thei hanelah na pawp awh.
Athakaawmnaw teh, kai taranlahoi a kamkhueng awh.
Oe BAWIPA, ka yonnae hoi kâtapoenae dawk nahoeh.
Ka payon hoeh e dawk hoi a yawng awh teh, a kâcai awh.
Thaw nateh, khenhaw! na kabawm haw.
Hatdawkvah, oe ransahu BAWIPA Cathut, Isarel Cathut,
miphun pueng rek hanlah thaw haw,
kâtapoe e tamikathoutnaw hah pahren hanh. Selah.
Tangmin vah a ban awh teh,
khopui a lawngven awh teh,
ui patetlah a rauk awh.
Ahnimouh teh, dudamnae lawk a dei awh teh,
ahnimae pahni dawk tahloi ao teh,
apinimouh a thai han aw ati awh.
Hatei, oe BAWIPA, ahnimouh teh na panuikhai han.
Miphun pueng teh nang hanlah panui ka tho e lah ao awh.
Oe nang, a tha kaawm e, pou na ring han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut teh kânguenae doeh.
Lungmakung Cathut ni, na dawn han.
Cathut ni ka tarannaw lathueng,
ka ngainae a pha sak e hah na hmu sak han.
Ahnimouh teh thet hanh.
Hoehpawiteh, ka taminaw ni a pahnim payon awh han doeh.
Oe BAWIPA, kaie bahling, na thaonae hoi kapek nateh,
koung rahnoum sak haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, a pahni dawk hoi a tâco sak e dei payonnae lawk kecu dawkvah,
a kâoupnae dawk kâman awh naseh.
Thoebonae hoi laithoe a dei awh.
Lungkhuek laihoi kahmat sak haw.
Hahoi Cathut ni Jakop lathueng vah,
lawk a ceng tie hah talai poutnae koe totouh panuek awh naseh.
Tangmin lah ban awh naseh.
Ui patetlah rauk laihoi khopui hah lawngven awh naseh.
Ca hane rawca a tawng awh teh,
a von a paha hoehroukrak a rauk awh.
Hatei, na thaonae hah la hoi ka sak han.
Amom vah na lungmanae hah,
kacaipounglah la hoi ka sak han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, nang teh ka kânguenae hoi
lungpout navah, ka yawngnae lah na o.
Oe ka thaonae, nang koe pholennae la ka sak han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut teh ka kânguenae lah ao teh,
lungmakung Cathut lah ao.
